comparison_identity.comparator: the passed!=applied marker form against a plain-English restatement of the same facts
comparison_identity.population: deterministic tokenizer roster cl100k_base,o200k_base (the named original's own roster)
comparison_identity.aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean: mean over pairs within one tokenizer, then the least-favourable (maximum) value across the roster members
comparison_identity.unit_span: one sentence pair: the plain-English restatement and its passed!=applied counterpart, counted as one unit

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
